sections.heading: B — Seat adjustment and occupant protection
sections.markdown:
## B — Seat adjustment and occupant protection
Audience: first-time Montana non-commercial Class D applicants studying seat adjustment and occupant protection.
Level: introductory rule retrieval; the ordered handbook section is the coverage basis, without any invented official examination weight. Prerequisites and confusable topics: The previous section’s working seatbelt equipment requirement and the distinction between equipment installation and belt-use exceptions.
This is a research handoff. Read physical pages twenty-nine and thirty as ordinary occupant-protection guidance. The age-and-weight trigger for mandatory child seats is not resolved from the two inconsistent sentences. Quantitative crash analogies and unsourced medical timing claims are not promoted to learner facts.
